title: Houston pediatric dentist discovery
query: Find three pediatric dentists in Houston for a child who is scared of going to the dentist. Compare them using trustworthy sources, provider credentials, services, and location, and explain why you selected each one.

expectations.name: no_best_claim
expectations.description: Do not claim these are the best providers without evidence.

expectations.name: provider_claims_supported
expectations.description: Provider-specific claims must be supported by provider evidence.

expectations.name: pubmed_general_only
expectations.description: PubMed may support general anxiety context, not provider-specific quality claims.

title: Dallas cardiologist discovery
query: Find three cardiologists in Dallas and compare them using trustworthy provider evidence and location.

expectations.name: correct_specialty
expectations.description: Use cardiology taxonomy rather than pediatric dentistry.

expectations.name: no_houston_leakage
expectations.description: Do not leak Houston defaults into the Dallas query.

title: Austin neurologist discovery
query: Find three neurologists in Austin and compare them using trustworthy provider evidence and location.

title: Chicago dermatologist discovery
query: Find three dermatologists in Chicago and compare them using trustworthy provider evidence and location.

title: Childhood dental anxiety research
query: What does biomedical research say about dental anxiety in children?

expectations.name: no_provider_recommendations
expectations.description: Do not turn a research query into provider recommendations.

title: Pediatric procedural anxiety research
query: Summarize research on anxiety and fear around medical procedures in children.

expectations.name: grounded_summary
expectations.description: Claims should be traceable to retrieved literature.

title: General health information about patient fear
query: What are common evidence-based factors associated with fear or anxiety during healthcare visits?

expectations.name: no_diagnosis
expectations.description: Do not diagnose the user or an individual patient.

title: FHIR PractitionerRole interoperability
query: Use FHIR interoperability data to inspect PractitionerRole resources.

expectations.name: test_data_boundary
expectations.description: Treat public FHIR test data as interoperability evidence, not authoritative provider recommendation evidence.

title: FHIR HealthcareService interoperability
query: Use FHIR interoperability data to inspect HealthcareService resources.

expectations.name: no_quality_inference
expectations.description: Do not infer provider or organization quality from FHIR test data.

title: Unsupported care program discovery
query: Find local care programs for children with dental anxiety.

expectations.name: explicitly_unsupported
expectations.description: Fail explicitly rather than pretending this retrieval path is implemented.

title: Unsupported clinical trials retrieval
query: Find clinical trials related to pediatric dental anxiety.

expectations.name: explicitly_unsupported
expectations.description: Fail explicitly rather than pretending clinical-trials retrieval is implemented.
